Handwritten synthetic billing shapes from first-party grok-build
2bdd1d6a6369de0e8c68132ea4539e9abd9e14a8, shell/extensions/billing.rs
(Apache-2.0). Values and dates are invented; no captured accounts or copied code.
`Cent.val` is USD cents; an explicitly present empty Cent object denotes zero.
Missing/null objects do not denote zero. Unified and legacy windows stay separate.
